newsitem.title: CZECH REPUBLIC: Czech CNB-120 index rises 0.8 points to 775.7 pts.
newsitem.headline: Czech CNB-120 index rises 0.8 points to 775.7 pts.

text.p: The CNB-120 index, a broad daily measure of Czech equities, rose 0.8 points, or 0.10 percent, on Tuesday to 775.7, the Czech National Bank (CNB) said.
Six of the ten sectoral indices lost, with the banking index losing the most, down 14.9 points, or 1.51 percent, to 972.7 points.
Four indices rose, with the energy index rising the most, up 14.8 points, or 1.62 percent, to 927 points.
